title: P1 GATE: her bare shape, A = the shipped body, B = ours (her_ek2_final, body-p1). Pick A or B.
sub: B tris: close body 76,088, play 21,284. Same head, same game cameras. ONE max judge (API, $0.87), its line per pair below; the owner's eyes are the pick. Defects are captioned, not fixed.

hip: Hip flex strips at 0 / 90 / 135 (B, close and play); 112 is measured only (close: 122 verts inside, max 37 mm; 135: 215 inside, max 25 mm). judge_E: 135 a hard dark straight line, the belly never rolls over the thigh. foot: MakeHuman (CC0) = the reference surface, slider shape samples, hand/foot templates, landmark targets, the head's ancestry. Ours = topology, correspondence, sliders, skeleton (hip, knee, spine, neck/head rules by anatomy), weights, correctives, UVs, the check.
